x_sigmafin_note: Reduced extract for pySigma's offline loader (sigma.data.mitre_d3fend.set_url). Source: https://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.json version 1.6.0, saved 2026-11-23. Keeps the ontology version, defensive tactics and technique ids and labels. Digital artifacts are omitted because no SigmaFin rule uses a d3fend tag. sigma check still loads this dataset for every tag, so the file is pinned to avoid a download. Refresh with scripts/refresh_mitre_data.py. See docs/attack-data.md.
